notes.text: The declarations printed on this certificate (that the tender was prepared independently, without collusion) are not filled in by the tenderer; they bind it once it signs. So only the certificate's presence, the tenderer's name, the signature and the date are checked.
Subcontracting the certificate mentions is disclosed in the Information Schedule, not here.
What follows a breach of the declarations is set out in the tender's terms; it is not assessed at the completeness check.
